resource.description: Required. The resource for which BPA needs to be created
resource.rationale: This is a resource reference and would require service-specific validation to confirm that the correct workload is being protected. It is not an explicit security control.

backup_plan.description: Required. The BP with which resource needs to be created Note: - A Backup Plan configured for 'compute.googleapis.com/Instance', can only protect instance type resources. - A Backup Plan configured for 'compute.googleapis.com/Disk' can be used to protect both standard Disks and Regional Disks resources.
backup_plan.rationale: This is a configuration setting and does not directly impact security.

resource_type.description: Required. The resource type of workload on which backupplan is applied. Examples include, "compute.googleapis.com/Instance", "compute.googleapis.com/Disk", and "compute.googleapis.com/RegionDisk"
resource_type.rationale: This affects workload compatibility and intended usage. This is a configuration setting and does not directly impact security.

location.description: Required. The GCP location for the backup vault should be on approved region.
location.rationale: Location is a clear generic security control because it can be enforced through an approved-region whitelist for governance and data residency.

backup_plan_association_id.description: Required. The id of backupplan association
backup_plan_association_id.rationale: ID is a configuration setting and does not directly impact security.

project.description: Optional. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project is an administrative scoping field used to determine where the resource is created. It does not directly define or enforce an explicit security control for the association itself.
